# samsung-artmode - Full Agent Operating Manual

A native Rust CLI for controlling Samsung The Frame TV Art Mode over the local network.
Results are YAML on stdout, errors are YAML or JSON on stderr, and `--json` switches both to machine-readable JSON.

## Target Device Resolution

Pass `--account <name>` (short `-a <name>`) or `--host <ip>` on every command. There is no implicit default device.

    samsung-artmode accounts list                      # what TVs are configured
    samsung-artmode status -a living-room              # check Art Mode status
    samsung-artmode status --host 192.168.1.100        # target by IP directly

If you do not know which TV to use, run `samsung-artmode accounts list` and ask the human.

### Pairing with a New TV

    samsung-artmode pair [host] [--name <name>]

1. If no host is provided, auto-discovers Samsung TVs on the local network via SSDP multicast.
2. Prompts the TV user on-screen: "Allow SamsungArtCli to connect?".
3. Obtains an authentication token from the TV.
4. If `--name <name>` is provided, saves the device configuration to `config.yaml` and stores the token in the OS Keystore (Keychain, DPAPI, libsecret).

## Complete Command Reference

### `pair`
```bash
samsung-artmode pair [HOST] [--name <NAME>] [--timeout <SECONDS>]
```
- `HOST`: Optional TV IP or hostname. If omitted, performs SSDP multicast scan on 239.255.255.250:1900.
- `--name <NAME>`: Optional account name to store in config and OS keystore.
- `--timeout <SECONDS>`: Scan/connection timeout in seconds (default: 5).

### `status`
```bash
samsung-artmode status [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
```
Returns `{ "status": "on" }` or `{ "status": "off" }`.

### `list`
```bash
samsung-artmode list [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>] [--category <CATEGORY>]
```
Lists images on the TV.
Categories:
- `MY-C0002`: My Photos (uploaded user photos)
- `MY-C0004`: Favorites
- `MY-C0008`: Samsung Art Store

### `current`
```bash
samsung-artmode current [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
```
Returns the content item currently displayed on the screen.

### `select`
```bash
samsung-artmode select <CONTENT_ID> [--show] [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
```
Selects an image to display.
- `CONTENT_ID`: Unique ID of the artwork (e.g. `SAM-F0206`).
- `--show`: Display immediately even if TV is not currently in art mode (default: true).

### `upload`
```bash
samsung-artmode upload <FILE> [--matte <MATTE_ID>] [--select] [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
```
Uploads a photo to the TV.
- `FILE`: Local path to JPEG or PNG image.
- `--matte <MATTE_ID>`: Optional matte style to apply.
- `--select`: Immediately set the uploaded image as active artwork.

### `delete`
```bash
samsung-artmode delete <CONTENT_ID> [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
```
Deletes an image from the TV.

### `favorite`
```bash
samsung-artmode favorite <CONTENT_ID> [--remove] [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
```
Adds or removes an image from Favorites (`MY-C0004`).

### `brightness`
```bash
samsung-artmode brightness get [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
samsung-artmode brightness set <0-10> [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
```
Queries or sets the display brightness between 0 (dimmest) and 10 (brightest).

### `matte`
```bash
samsung-artmode matte list [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
samsung-artmode matte set <CONTENT_ID> <MATTE_ID> [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
```
Lists supported mattes or applies a matte to an image.
Common matte IDs:
- `none`
- `flexible_polar`
- `shadowbox_black`
- `modern_warm`

### `slideshow`
```bash
samsung-artmode slideshow [--interval <MINUTES>] [--category <CATEGORY>] [--shuffle] [--off] [-a <ACCOUNT> | --host <HOST>]
```
Configures or disables the rotating slideshow.

### `accounts`
```bash
samsung-artmode accounts list
samsung-artmode accounts add <NAME> --host <HOST> [--token <TOKEN>] [--mac <MAC>] [--model <MODEL>] [--force]
samsung-artmode accounts test <NAME>
samsung-artmode accounts remove <NAME> [--yes]
```
Manages multi-TV configurations and credential storage.

## Exit Codes & Error Envelope

Failures print to stderr with a stable numeric exit code and structured envelope:

    0  ok
    1  error          unclassified error
    2  network        TV unreachable or socket connection lost
    3  auth_required  TV refused connection or invalid token; re-pair TV
    4  not_found      content ID or file not found
    5  rate_limited   back off before retrying
    6  invalid_input  invalid argument value
    7  no_account     missing --account or --host parameter

Error Envelope Format:
```json
{
  "error": "Error description message",
  "code": "auth_required",
  "detail": "Underlying diagnostic details",
  "remediation": "samsung-artmode pair 192.168.1.100"
}
```
